notes.title: Devlog #11
notes.content:
Beginnings are often complicated. It takes a lot of work and effort to reach the top. If you need cash to start, you should be interested in forgotten cars. These are mainly rusty and broken vehicles scattered around the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/e5f90a2028b85d07bf1ceccb679852dec664d877.png[/img]

After purchasing the forgotten one, your task will be to restore it to working condition. Also, all unusable parts must be replaced. And don’t forget about your safety. The car should look good, damaged and rotten body parts have to go to the bin. Try not to let the police find out about your actions. Any suspicious purchase can attract their attention. Win races with discretion.

If you are interested in these topics, be sure to visit our Discord and check other social media. Share your opinion in the comments section!

notes.title: Devlog #10
notes.content:
Welcome to the next devlog!

Street racing will be your primary source of income. On what is quite apparent, you will earn the most. But it is always worth having some plan B. If you fail to break through and still need money, the option to increase cash by working on someone else’s cars comes to your aid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/62c258ee899d6778a1c625d1ab8cff884ead628a.png[/img]

You will have access to a unique database where people will provide their vehicles for repair/tuning with given criteria on what to do. It is up to you what car you choose and whose. 

The Outlaw’s world will be divided into districts managed by other gangs. If you would like to maintain a positive relationship with one of them or improve your connection, you will be able to accept orders from its members (of course, car orders). Every detail has to be refined. After all, none of you wants to run into competition. We hope everybody will be adequately prepared for any eventuality. See you guys in the next devlog. Stay tuned for more info and visit our social media!

notes.title: Devlog #9
notes.content:
Hi there!

Probably each of you dreamed that after buying your first car you would be able to tune it freely. It is best if it is unique and people want to take pictures with it. Well, in Outlaw Driver Simulator you will have that opportunity. In this devlog we will describe some tuning options.

Let’s start with what tuning actually is. This is the improvement of the current appearance of the car by equipping it with accessories not available in the original version. Tuning gives a car an individual look and also is improving quality and performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/859aad7bfccc0c60c92c4c592b12a3ec11f23367.gif[/img]

Optical and mechanical tuning will be possible in the game. You will be able to change the rims, tires, replace headlamps. Tinted windows, rear spoiler, and changing the exhaust system will make this car perfect for street racing. And improving the braking system will make you feel safer. To boost the performance, you will be able to relieve the car by fitting lighter parts, 
 or e.g. upgrade the gearbox and use a lighter clutch. You will also be able to upgrade your workshop. All you have to do is win the races and invest in improvements.

Thank you for your attention. Take a look at our social media. See you in the next devlog!


[url=https://discord.gg/tXCGMScAZp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/c73f3ed162437474e347590a9955ff35bb9603ab.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
Today we’ll talk a little bit about escaping the police. Not everything has to go our way in an illegal race. What if we fail? You have to be prepared for every eventuality. The cops are smart too, and it won’t always be easy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/94444ea3d277178fab84155cd686e71b38983d50.png[/img]

During the chase, you will have to watch out for many obstacles. The police are well prepared. There are blockades waiting for you, roll-up spikes on the streets, etc. It is also worth paying attention to other people’s cars and traffic. If you can avoid arrest and unfortunately damage your car, then you will have to invest in repairs. You better be careful.


In the worst case, when the police catch you and put you in jail, you will have to be prepared to pay bail. Wish you had a plan B and something for a rainy day.

That’s all for today. I hope, that you’re excited. Let us know in the comments section what’re your feelings? See you soon, check our social media!

notes.content:
Hi!

Here you have a glimpse of the next part of the car that you can have in Outlaw Driver Simulator. Today we choose rims to show you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/03c530c942d3af990b5a7bef0839b2e646b0b55a.jpg[/img]

The rim is the load-bearing member of the car chassis onto which the tires are mounted. Its function is to transmit forces from the wheel hub to the tire, and to cool (ventilate) the braking system. So as you see it’s important to have good ones.

Playing Outlaw Driver Simulator you can see familiar places from other games like Chop Shop Simulator, Car Scrapyard Simulator, Illegal Transporter and Emergency Road Service. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/e562fe5bc9042fa32eb20cb30f7ead7613aa2dfe.png[/img]

Hello drivers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/d0c84539db72c121dc58b7e3514c8f2ff877948a.png[/img]

Some places aren’t safe so don’t go there alone unless you want to confront some gangs. They are dangerous, some of them are a little bit crazy but they love to feel the adrenaline and take part in street racing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/6c008ab55ba332909fc6a887580ef6d390db55b3.png[/img]

Choose your friends wisely.

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/116ea4f9ecc2449ae8b28db6bda1038c7013a1c0.png[/img]
Is your car ready to be the first one on the finish line? 

Yes? 

Great! 

So now it’s time to test it in the street race! Find on the map one of the illegal races or accept a challenge was sent to your mobile phone. 

Heat your wheels before starting. To do that, use at the same time accelerator and a brake pedal. After you reach the right temperature, you can position it on the starting line. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/f53b8da268ea37c8a4495650532d5f3d736a43f2.png[/img]

While you will wait on the green light, manipulate engine rotation to have a perfect start, and then(...) try to win. 

You have ½ or ¼ mile to overtake your opponent. Remember, you have to manually change gear! Show your driving skills and be the first one. 

After every win, you get cash which you can spend on upgrading your car! 

Tell us: what we should discuss next?!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello there!

Today, as I said before, we will talk about upgrading and taking care of cars. 

To beat other racers you need to upgrade your car using the workshop and equipment which is there. 
You have the opportunity to replace individual car parts with lighter and more powerful equivalents, and monitor the performance of his vehicle at test stations. Change serial parts to the more racing ones and install  additional parts (e.g. spoilers)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214054/2ad925b98b282ba066e2bcaeb3515adf1f5ee7cc.png[/img]

Buying parts is done from a computer and phone in the workshop. You can order mechanical and visual parts for your cars.

After each race, you should also take care of the oil quantities, change the tires (choose the best tires for the weather conditions for the next race) and other wear and tear (or broken down during the race through misuse of the car, or neglect of parts, i.e. a seized engine) of the vehicle.

That’s all for now. Do you like that? Let us know in the comments or [b]on our Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/3jjxqnxQTw][i]https://discord.gg/3jjxqnxQTw[/i][/url]).[/b] Tell us also what you want to know in the next devlogs.

notes.title: Devblog #1
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/j5scDyp.png[/img]

[b]Hello [i]Drivers![/i][/b]
We are very pleased to meet you. We are the team responsible for the communication of the [b]Outlaw Driver Simulator[/b] project. We want to bring you closer to the content related to our game. We hope to diversify your waiting time for the premiere with our posts.

As you probably already know, Outlaw Driver Simulator will focus on the simulation of car mechanics and illegal underground racing. We'd like to keep the experience realistic in every aspect.

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/r4pmhzezZtt5OxFjqR/giphy.gif[/img]

In today's post, we focus on police scuffles. Open-World police chases are probably something that captures your imagination, and rightly so! They can not only harm the conduct of the race but also immediately after it. You have to be vigilant at all times and keep your finger on the pulse or the steering wheel ;) Being caught by the cops may result in suspension, a fine, or in the worst case, imprisonment. You wouldn't just want to see cars on the prison walls, would you? We will try to make each police chase full of excitement so that you do not feel monotony but excitement.
